explanation: Singleton restricts instantiation to one object via private constructor and static accessor.
Factory pattern centralizes object creation, decoupling client from concrete classes.
Builder pattern constructs complex objects step-by-step with fluent API.
Observer pattern decouples subjects from observers via events/delegates.
Strategy pattern defines family of algorithms as interchangeable strategies.
Decorator wraps objects to add behavior, avoiding explosion of subclasses.
Adapter converts one interface to another, enabling cooperation between incompatible types.
